task: Brief the team on the approved branching-strategy decision, why it was chosen, and what it replaced.
project_summary: A six-person engineering team is standardising how it ships. After two weeks of friction with long-lived branches, it has agreed on a new workflow and needs everyone (and any AI tool helping) to follow the same rules.
current_direction: Move to trunk-based development with short-lived branches and feature flags; the previous GitFlow approach is retired.

decisions.title: Adopt trunk-based development with short-lived branches
decisions.body: Everyone integrates to main daily behind feature flags; branches live at most 2 days.
decisions.rationale: Long-lived develop/release branches caused painful merges and slow, batched releases.
decisions.tradeoffs: Requires disciplined feature flagging and a green main at all times; accepted for faster, safer releases.
decisions.outcome: Approved by the team lead after a two-week trial across two squads.

evidence.claim: Small, frequent merges reduce integration risk and speed up delivery

decisions.title: Gate unfinished work behind feature flags, not branches
decisions.body: Incomplete features ship dark behind a flag rather than living on a branch.
decisions.rationale: Keeps main releasable while work is in progress.

sources.label: Trunk Based Development
sources.bound_claim: Small, frequent merges reduce integration risk and speed up delivery

constraints: main must always be releasable (green CI).
No branch may live longer than two days.
boundaries: This pack states the decision + rationale; it does not migrate any repository.
what_to_avoid: Re-introducing long-lived develop/release branches — that is the GitFlow approach the team retired.
open_questions: What is the feature-flag cleanup policy so flags don't accumulate?
next_steps: Document the branching rules in the repo's CONTRIBUTING guide.
Add a flag-cleanup checklist to the definition of done for flagged work.

version_history.label: GitFlow
version_history.summary: Long-lived develop/release branches; retired after the two-week trunk-based trial.

definition_of_done: Every engineer (and any AI tool briefed with this pack) integrates to a releasable main daily behind feature flags, with no branch older than two days.

recommended_assistant.reason: This communicates and plans a team process decision; it is not a coding or research task.
